About Team SkyLink & UTB Bahrain

SkyLink is the official CanSat competition team from the University of Technology Bahrain (UTB). Our signature Grey, Red, and White palette unites our aerospace carbon-grey chassis with the proud crimson red and pure white of the Kingdom of Bahrain flag and UTB.

🪂 Parachute Mechanics

Dual-stage descent control and aerodynamic stabilization for safe recovery.

📡 Live Telemetry

High-reliability atmospheric sensing, GPS tracking, and aerial imaging.
